title: The alignment figures
audit_anchor: #include "rules/audits/r877_batch.h"  // R877: R877 Appendix 4 and index audit
audit_comment: THE ALIGNMENT FIGURES - the D&DG walk round thirty, print p. 131 (pdf 132): FIG. 4 the character alignment graph and FIG. 5 the planes of alignment - the LAST D&DG tail page, and the pixel round: both text voices read near-zero here (the tesseract pass and the IA djvu - line art), so the evidence is the pdftoppm renders (committed c8bf507 and 1028ebe) read by the vision passes, collated against the TSV label geometry, with the TARTARUS eyeball by Curtiss. THE GAP FLIP: the alignment figures box closes - the ddg report reads 24/0, the walk COMPLETE. THE HEADLINE ADJUDICATIONS: the four curved descriptors ride the four corner alignments (Saintly LG, Beatific CG, Diabolic LE, Demoniac CE - the crescent regions); the settled structure read - CURVED dividers converging at the center, not crossing Venn lenses; the center circle NEUTRAL (the true neutral); the NEUTRAL EVIL label and the center circle vision-only (the TSV misses them); the FIG. 5 wheel - sixteen segments, straight radial dividers, plane names only, no arrows; ELYSIUM the top segment, HADES the bottom, CONCORDANT OPPOSITION the center; the cycle reads the p. 129 list order clockwise; the figure spells TARTARUS where the list reads Tarterus - the figure-vs-list delta, both pinned as printed. The wheel matches the Appendix 1 seventeen-planes pin. ZERO registry defs touched - the floor holds at 995.

data_files.content:
The DDG print p. 131 FIG. 4 CHARACTER ALIGNMENT GRAPH - the D&DG walk
round thirty, the pixel round. Both text voices (the extract/ddg
tesseract pass and the archive.org 1st-print djvu) read near-zero on
this page - line art; the evidence is the pdftoppm renders (300/600/
1200 dpi, committed c8bf507 and 1028ebe) read by the vision passes,
collated against the tesseract TSV label geometry, with the TARTARUS
eyeball confirmation by Curtiss.

The graph: a circle divided by CURVED lines converging at the center
(crescent regions, not crossing Venn lenses), the small center circle
reading NEUTRAL (the true neutral), the eight wedge labels printed as
stacked two-line caps. The four curved descriptors ride the four
corner alignments: Saintly arcs the LAWFUL GOOD region, Beatific the
CHAOTIC GOOD, Diabolic the LAWFUL EVIL, Demoniac the CHAOTIC EVIL;
the axis wedges and the center carry none.

The nine alignments, the print reading order (the wedge labels
top-to-bottom then left-to-right, the center circle last), with the
compass position and the descriptor ordinal (0 = none):

0. NEUTRAL GOOD - north, no descriptor
1. LAWFUL GOOD - northwest, Saintly
2. CHAOTIC GOOD - northeast, Beatific
3. LAWFUL NEUTRAL - west, no descriptor
4. CHAOTIC NEUTRAL - east, no descriptor
5. LAWFUL EVIL - southwest, Diabolic
6. NEUTRAL EVIL - south, no descriptor
7. CHAOTIC EVIL - southeast, Demoniac
8. NEUTRAL (the center circle) - center, no descriptor

The tesseract TSV anchors the readable labels (NEUTRAL GOOD 202, LAW-
FUL GOOD 463, CHAOTIC GOOD 464, LAWFUL NEUTRAL 853, CHAOTIC
NEUTRAL 854, LAWFUL 1193, CHAOTIC 1193, EVIL 1241 at the 300-dpi
page); the NEUTRAL EVIL label and the center circle are vision-only.

The DDG print p. 131 FIG. 5 THE PLANES OF ALIGNMENT - the D&DG walk
round thirty, the pixel round. The wheel: sixteen segments around the
center circle reading CONCORDANT OPPOSITION, divided by straight
radial lines, each segment carrying only its plane name, no arrows or
connecting marks. The evidence: the pdftoppm renders read by the
vision passes (see ddg_fig4.txt for the voice note).

The wheel cycle reads the print p. 129 list order CLOCKWISE, with
ELYSIUM at the top segment (the neutral good pole, the FIG. 4 compass
shared), HADES at the bottom, CONCORDANT OPPOSITION at the center.
The seventeen planes (the p. 129 list ordinals, the FIGURE
spellings - the figure prints TARTARUS where the list reads Tarterus,
both pinned as printed):

1. Seven Heavens - clockwise segment 15
2. Twin Paradises - segment 16
3. Elysium - segment 1 (the top)
4. Happy Hunting Grounds - segment 2
5. Olympus - segment 3
6. Gladsheim - segment 4
7. Limbo - segment 5
8. Pandemonium - segment 6
9. Abyss - segment 7
10. Tartarus - segment 8 (the bottom-right of Hades)
11. Hades - segment 9 (the bottom)
12. Gehenna - segment 10
13. Nine Hells - segment 11
14. Acheron - segment 12
15. Nirvana - segment 13
16. Arcadia - segment 14
17. Concordant Opposition - the center (segment 0)

The wheel matches the Appendix 1 seventeen-planes pin (rules/pln.h,
the plnOutSeventeenCount doctrine): the alignment bands follow the
FIG. 4 compass - the lawful planes upper-left, the chaotic
upper-right, the good pole up, the evil pole down.
